the multiparametric system is a valuable tool for studying the effects of ICP elevation in a rat model.
the MPA system provides a reliable method for monitoring the brain under elevated ICP.

the MPA is capable of monitoring the physiological state of the brain in real time, providing a valuable tool to investigate the influence on the brain of elevated ICP.
